title: TouchStation device tuning
note: Guidance for settings exposed by the bundled RPCS3-derived emulator. These profiles do not overclock hardware, change voltage, install drivers, or guarantee that a game will run.

common.resolutionScale: 100% baseline; lower only if performance is poor
common.gameProfiles: Use per-game settings rather than forcing one global configuration

dimensity.label: MediaTek Dimensity
notes: Mali and Immortalis GPU support varies by generation and driver.
Keep default RSX accuracy first; reduce resolution before changing advanced accuracy options.
Expect sustained-load throttling on thin phones.

snapdragon.label: Qualcomm Snapdragon

recommendedStartingPoint.resolutionScale: 100%; test higher only after a game is stable

notes: Adreno driver capabilities vary by Snapdragon generation.
Use the system Vulkan driver by default; do not install unofficial driver packages as a generic fix.
Per-game compatibility settings are more reliable than a global high-performance preset.

exynos.label: Samsung Exynos
notes: Exynos devices use different GPU families across generations, including Mali and Xclipse.
Confirm Vulkan support on the specific device; GPU driver maturity differs by model.
Prefer safe defaults and per-game profiles over aggressive global changes.
